title: We Got Turned Into An Anime Again
overview: Bakabon and his family are back in this new anime after 18 years of being off the air. Are they ready for this new era, or have things changed way too much?

title: This Is a Pain / I Want Women to Like Me
overview: Unagi Inu takes up his doggish duty to wake up the stars of the show. / The Policeman takes Unagi Inu, Papa, and Rerere to a mixer in the hopes he can score a date.

title: We're Going to Be in a Movie / I Want a Third
overview: Bakabon and his family end up in a movie. / Papa decides that he wants a third child, but has completely forgotten how to make one.

title: Microtransactions! The Genius Bakabon / Anthropomorphize It
overview: Papa is visited by two of his underclassmen from Bakada University. The first one can’t seem to stop paying for microtransactions and the second needs ideas for a new otome game featuring anthropomorphic characters.

title: We Test the Limits of Late Night!
overview: Papa and the others push the limits for a late-night anime of their caliber.

title: Anime is Hard
overview: Papa decides he's going to become a manga artist so he can buy Bakabon a prime-time broadcast slot.

title: We'll Do a Presentation / I Want to Become a Popular Seiyuu
overview: One of Papa’s Bakada underclassmen visits again and decides to make slideshow presentations about everything.

title: I Want Some Action / Unagi Inu's Memorial Service
overview: The Policeman becomes interested in wanting to stand out more. / Unagi Inu must attend a funeral.

title: Mr. Policeman's Aptitude Test / Real Genius Bakabon
overview: The Policeman undergoes an aptitude test to see if he's really cut out for his line of work. / Bakabon gets real.

title: Genius Hajime
overview: Hajime makes a time machine and the family visits the future.

title: Goodbye, Everyone
overview: Bakabon and Hajime travel into the past to try to prevent their father from turning into an idiot.

title: This is the Actual Final Episode
overview: This is it. Show's done. We promise.
